Emphasis: *italic*, _also italic_, **bold**, __also bold__, ***bold italic***,
**bold with *nested italic* inside**, ~~strikethrough~~, ~single tilde~.

Escapes: \*not italic\*, \# not heading, \[not a link\], 1\. not a list.

Entities: &amp; &lt; &gt; &copy; &#169; &#x1F600; &nbsp;end.

Links: [inline](https://example.com), [with title](https://example.com "Title"),
[reference][ref], [collapsed][], [shortcut], <https://auto.link>,
<user@example.com>, https://www.bare-url.org, [relative](docs/guide.md),
[anchor](#section), [[WikiLink]].

[ref]: https://example.org/reference
[collapsed]: https://example.org/collapsed
[shortcut]: https://example.org/shortcut

Line with trailing spaces for a hard break  
next line, and a backslash break\
last line.

Footnotes[^note] and more[^long].

[^note]: A short note.
[^long]: A longer footnote that has enough text to wrap onto a second line when the width is small.

Inline math $E = mc^2$ and $\int_0^\infty e^{-x} dx = 1$.

Superscript-like text: x^2^ and H~2~O.
